prompt:
A finished desktop website homepage design, first viewport plus the start of the next section, 1536x1024 landscape, flat full-frame screen design (not a device photo). Product: Chevron7, a free native macOS app for qualified electronic signatures (KEP). All text in Slovak. Craft level of apple.com Pro app pages, Things by Cultured Code and Raycast: huge confident SF-Pro-like grotesque typography, generous space, one idea per viewport, real product UI as the hero. Use the attached reference image ONLY as the app icon (a dark midnight glass squircle with a glowing amber upward chevron and a small white point of origin above it); keep its colors: midnight navy #0B1020, amber #FFB23E, warm white. Nav bar: the small icon plus "Chevron7" left; "Podpisovanie", "Štátne weby", "Mobilom", "Zaručená konverzia" center; "SK / EN" and a pill button "Stiahnuť" right. Primary action "Stiahnuť pre macOS", secondary "Zdrojový kód na GitHube", tiny line "macOS 27 · Apple Silicon · zadarmo · EUPL-1.2". Headline "Kvalifikovaný podpis. Natívne na Macu." Subline "Podpíšte PDF kartou eID, I.CA alebo iPhonom cez NFC. Dokumenty ostávajú na vašom Macu." Any app window shows the real Chevron7 SwiftUI layout: sidebar with "Podpisovanie", "Zaručená konverzia", "Register konverzií" and history "Podpísané"; center a PDF preview of a contract page; right an inspector with "Formát: PAdES", "Certifikát", "Vizuálny podpis", "Časová pečiatka" toggle, and a large button "Podpísať KEP"; bottom status bar "Čítačka: eID karta pripravená". No people, no stock photos, no rings, no hieroglyphs, no pyramids, no shields, no gradient blobs.

COMPOSITION 1 (centered classic): dark midnight page. The app icon large and centered near the top with a soft amber glow, then the centered headline in two lines, subline, the two actions side by side, the tiny line. From the bottom third a large realistic Chevron7 app window rises, cropped by the bottom edge, its "Podpísať KEP" button lit amber. One focal moment: the window.
